prompt:
Use the provided approved Pass Through composition as the reference for identity, material, perspective, and light. This is conceptual artwork for Mohanad Yehia's QA portfolio. Dark chrome with subtle real texture, optically transparent amber glass with precise light at its edges, graphite #161514, controlled white reflection bands. Preserve the sophisticated physical finish and macro-scale inspection metaphor. No lettering, no numbers, no logos, no UI, no dashboard, no technology symbols, no new objects.
Create the clean production background plate, 1536x1024, matching the full reference camera and the exact placement and silhouette of its material layers. Remove ALL text and controls: brand, navigation, headline, QA role, description, buttons, TestPulse, and its subtitle. Fill removed lettering with the underlying dark graphite or material as appropriate. Preserve the calm left field and the large close layers across the right, the upper chrome slab, amber sheets, lower foreground, texture and lighting. Keep the framing unchanged. The artwork is edge to edge, with no letterboxing or added vignette. The TestPulse area becomes an empty dark viewing slot. Do not flatten the glass or change the palette.
